key_insight: A hybrid quantum-classical surrogate can approximate the nonlinear BGK collision operator of the lattice Boltzmann method across the full relaxation range without retraining.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to embed quantum machine learning into fluid simulation workflows while preserving the accuracy needed for engineering-grade flow prediction.
method: Uses a parameterized quantum circuit as a surrogate model for collision dynamics
Employs data re-uploading to expand the representable frequency spectrum
Evaluates VQC metrics such as expressibility, entanglement, and effective dimension against task performance
evidence_signal: The surrogate is validated on benchmark flows, including Taylor-Green vortex and double shear layer cases, to test energy dissipation and nonlinear instability behavior.
watch_item: Performance depends on circuit design and surrogate training quality, and the approach still relies on a classical-quantum hybrid workflow rather than a fully quantum fluid solver.
paper_title: A Quantum-Classical Surrogate Model for the Collision Operator of the Lattice Boltzmann Method
